newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Sony Music, JR East plan new building.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Sony Music, JR East plan new building.

text.p: Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc said on Monday that it and East Japan Railway Co (JR East) would jointly build an office tower in central Tokyo for about 18 billion yen.
The tower, which will also house recording studios, will be built on about 3,400 sq metres of land JR East owns in the Akasaka district, Sony Music said in a statement.
It is expected to be completed by the end of March 2000, Sony Music said.
Details of the project, including the size of the firms' investment, have not been decided, a Sony Music spokesman said.
But Sony Music will try to provide details of the project when it announces its earnings for the year to March 31, 1997, on May 7, he said.

Sony Music does not expect the project to have much of an impact on its earnings, he said. After the project is completed, Sony will sell its building in Shinanomachi, Tokyo, which houses a recording studio, a company spokesman said.
